arxiv-2106-12047.title: Fluctuations of water quality time series in rivers follow superstatistics
arxiv-2106-12047.creator: Benjamin Schäfer, Catherine M. Heppell, Hefin Rhys, Christian Beck
arxiv-2106-12047.description: Abstract Superstatistics is a general method from nonequilibrium statistical physics which has been applied to a variety of complex systems, ranging from hydrodynamic turbulence to traffic delays and air pollution dynamics. Here, we investigate water quality time series (such as dissolved oxygen concentrations and electrical conductivity) as measured in rivers, and provide evidence that they exhibit superstatistical behaviour.

arxiv-2204-07479.title: Gagliardo-Nirenberg inequality in anisotropic Lebesgue spaces and energy equality in the Navier-Stokes equations
arxiv-2204-07479.creator: Yanqing Wang, Xue Mei and Wei Wei
arxiv-2204-07479.description: Abstract In this paper, it is shown that an analogue in mixed norm spaces of Gagliardo-Nirenberg inequality is valid. As an application, some new criteria for energy conservation of Leray-Hopf weak solutions to the 3D Navier-Stokes equations are established in these spaces, which extend the corresponding known results.

arxiv-2212-07544.title: A statistical perspective on microsolvation
arxiv-2212-07544.creator: Mohammad Rahbar, Christopher J. Stein
arxiv-2212-07544.description: Abstract The lack of a procedure to determine equilibrium thermodynamic properties of a small system interacting with a bath is frequently seen as a weakness of conventional statistical mechanics. A typical example for such a small system is a solute surrounded by an explicit solvation shell.

arxiv-2212-11550.title: Weak convergence of Monge-Ampère measures on compact Hermitian manifolds
arxiv-2212-11550.creator: Sławomir Kołodziej and Ngoc Cuong Nguyen
arxiv-2212-11550.description: Abstract . We give a sufficient condition on a sequence of uniformly bounded ω \omega -plurisubharmonic functions, ω \omega being a Hermitian metric, for which the sequence of associated Monge-Ampère measures converges weakly. This criterion can be used to obtained a bounded ω \omega -plurisubharmonic solution to the Monge-Ampère equation. 1.

arxiv-2311-17705.title: Q-PAC: Automated Detection of Quantum Bug-Fix Patterns
arxiv-2311-17705.creator: Pranav K. Nayak, Krishn V. Kher, M. Bharat Chandra, M. V. Panduranga Rao, Lei Zhang
arxiv-2311-17705.description: Abstract Context : Bug-fix pattern detection has been investigated in the past in the context of classical software. However, while quantum software is developing rapidly, the literature still lacks automated methods and tools to identify, analyze, and detect bug-fix patterns.

arxiv-2403-09519.title: Efficient tensor networks for control-enhanced quantum metrology
arxiv-2403-09519.creator: Qiushi Liu, Yuxiang Yang
arxiv-2403-09519.description: Abstract Optimized quantum control can enhance the performance and noise resilience of quantum metrology. However, the optimization quickly becomes intractable when multiple control operations are applied sequentially. In this work, we propose efficient tensor network algorithms for optimizing strategies of quantum metrology enhanced by a long sequence of control operations.

arxiv-2406-04342.title: Learning 1D Causal Visual Representation with De-focus Attention Networks
arxiv-2406-04342.creator: Chenxin Tao 1,3, Xizhou Zhu, Shiqian Su, Lewei Lu, Changyao Tian, Xuan Luo, Gao Huang, Hongsheng Li, Yu Qiao, Jie Zhou, Jifeng Dai
arxiv-2406-04342.description: Abstract Modality differences have led to the development of heterogeneous architectures for vision and language models. While images typically require 2D non-causal modeling, texts utilize 1D causal modeling. This distinction poses significant challenges in constructing unified multi-modal models. This paper explores the feasibility of representing images using 1D causal modeling.

arxiv-2407-10904.title: Measurement of the associated production of a top-antitop-quark pair and a Higgs boson decaying into a b ​ b ¯ b\bar{b} pair in p ​ p pp collisions at s = 13 \sqrt{s}=13 TeV using the ATLAS detector at the LHC
arxiv-2407-10904.description: Abstract This paper reports the measurement of Higgs boson production in association with a t ​ t ¯ t\bar{t} pair in the H → b ​ b ¯ H\rightarrow b\bar{b} decay channel. The analysis uses 140 fb -1 of 13 TeV proton–proton collision data collected with the ATLAS detector at the Large Hadron Collider.

arxiv-2407-18702.title: Partial Adaptive Indexing for Approximate Query Answering
arxiv-2407-18702.creator: Stavros Maroulis, Nikos Bikakis, Vassilis Stamatopoulos, George Papastefanatos
arxiv-2407-18702.description: Abstract . In data exploration, users need to analyze large data files quickly, aiming to minimize data-to-analysis time. While recent adaptive indexing approaches address this need, they are cases where demonstrate poor performance. Particularly, during the initial queries, in regions with a high density of objects, and in very large files over commodity hardware.

arxiv-2503-01419.title: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of Large Language Models via Deconvolution in Subspace
arxiv-2503-01419.creator: Jia-Chen Zhang, Yu-Jie Xiong, Chun-Ming Xia, Dong-Hai Zhu, Xi-He Qiu
arxiv-2503-01419.description: Abstract Large language model (LLM) is considered a milestone towards achieving Artificial General Intelligence (AGI). With its advanced emergent capabilities, it adapt to a wide range of specific applications. Fine-tuning LLMs for various downstream tasks has become a new paradigm. Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) is well-known for its parameter efficiency.

arxiv-2505-23233.title: Mind the Gap: A Formal Investigation of the Relationship Between Log and Model Complexity – Extended Version
arxiv-2505-23233.creator: Patrizia Schalk, Artem Polyvyanyy
arxiv-2505-23233.description: Abstract Simple process models are key for effectively communicating the outcomes of process mining. An important question in this context is whether the complexity of event logs used as inputs to process discovery algorithms can serve as a reliable indicator of the complexity of the resulting process models.

arxiv-2510-09477.title: Efficient Autoregressive Inference for Transformer Probabilistic Models
arxiv-2510-09477.creator: Conor Hassan, Nasrulloh Loka, Cen-You Li, Daolang Huang, Paul E. Chang, Yang Yang, Francesco Silvestrin, Samuel Kaski, Luigi Acerbi, [0.3em] Department of Computer Science, Aalto University, Finland
arxiv-2510-09477.description: Abstract Transformer-based models for amortized probabilistic inference, such as neural processes, prior-fitted networks, and tabular foundation models, excel at single-pass marginal prediction. However, many real-world applications – from signal interpolation to multi-column tabular predictions – require coherent joint distributions that capture dependencies between predictions.

arxiv-2512-22362.title: On the number of words of N = 3 ​ M N=3\,M letters with a three-letter alphabet
arxiv-2512-22362.creator: Pablo Serra
arxiv-2512-22362.description: Abstract In this paper we address the well-known problem of counting the number of 3 ​ M 3M -letter words that can be formed from a three-letter alphabet by decomposing it into four possible cases based on its remainder when divided by three. The solution to the problem also gives us some sums of trinomial coefficients.

pmc-10601419.title: Vertex-Based Resolvability Parameters for Identification of Certain Chemical Structures
pmc-10601419.creator: Malkesh Singh, Sunny Kumar Sharma, Vijay Kumar Bhat
pmc-10601419.description: Chemical graph theory explores chemical phenomena and entities through the conceptual framework of graph theory. In chemical graph theory, molecular structures are represented by chemical graphs, where edges and vertices correspond to bonds and atoms, respectively. Chemical graphs serve as fundamental data types in cheminformatics for illustrating chemical structures.

pmc-12569393.title: Joint coordination constraints using an upper limb exoskeleton impact novel skill acquisition
pmc-12569393.creator: Keya Ghonasgi, Reuth Mirsky, Adrian M Haith, Peter Stone, Ashish D Deshpande
pmc-12569393.description: Robotic exoskeletons offer the potential to train novel motor skill acquisition and thus aid physical rehabilitation. Our prior work demonstrated that individuals converge to certain kinematic coordinations as they learn a novel task. An upper-limb exoskeleton controller that constrains individuals to this known coordination was also shown to significantly improve straight-line reaching task performance.

pmc-12572731.title: Nonlinear Relationship Between Triglyceride‐to‐High‐Density Lipoprotein Cholesterol Ratio and Non‐Alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease: A Secondary Retrospective Analysis Based on a Japanese Longitudinal Study
pmc-12572731.creator: Lingde Shen, Yuanfang Lin, Weifeng Chen, Dan Zhou, Hui Peng
pmc-12572731.description: BackgroundThe purpose of this research is to investigate the particular connection between the triglyceride to high‐density lipoprotein cholesterol (TG/HDL‐C) ratio and non‐alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD) to offer a more precise foundation for evaluating NAFLD risk.MethodsThis study involves a secondary analysis of a retrospective cohort study conducted from 2004 to 2015 in a Japanese population, which included 14,106 participants.

pmc-13075941.title: Early pannus after transcatheter heart valve implantation leading to delayed coronary obstruction: a case report
pmc-13075941.creator: Louis Perrard, Alexandre Lafont, Mariama Akodad, Patrick Nataf, Emmanuel Gall
pmc-13075941.description: BackgroundCoronary obstruction after transcatheter aortic valve implantation (TAVI) is a rare complication typically occurring acutely. Delayed coronary obstruction (DCO) due to early pannus formation is exceptionally uncommon.Case summaryA 74-year-old woman with no coronary artery disease underwent TAVI with a self-expandable 26-mm Evolut Pro + (Medtronic) transcatheter heart valve (THV) six months prior.

pmc-13147455.title: From early-onset asthma to chronic obstructive pulmonary disease: potential mediating proteins and therapeutic targets
pmc-13147455.creator: Yuhan Jiang, Ju Guo, Yifan Wang, Run Guo, Yongjian Wei, Tianchun Li, Xuelin Wang, Ruiwen Xia, Wanyi Li, Yingxue Zou, Hongxi Yang
pmc-13147455.description: Background and objectiveEarly-onset asthma (EOA) significantly increases the risk of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), yet the causal mechanisms and molecular mediators underlying this progression remain poorly understood. Multi-omics integration provides a powerful framework for prioritizing potential mediating proteins and disease-specific therapeutic candidates.

pmc-13676832.title: Pharmacological Modulation of Catecholaminergic Brain Injury by Dapagliflozin and Its Nanovesicular Formulation in an Isoproterenol Model
pmc-13676832.creator: Faisal Ashraf Bhat, Syed Ehtaishamul Haque, Mohammed Aqil, Mohd Akhtar, Abul Kalam Najmi
pmc-13676832.description: Sustained β‐adrenergic stimulation represents a pharmacologically relevant stressor capable of inducing systemic oxidative and inflammatory injury that extends to the central nervous system. Isoproterenol (ISO), a synthetic catecholamine, is widely used to model catecholaminergic injury in experimental settings. Dapagliflozin, a sodium–glucose cotransporter‐2 (SGLT2) inhibitor, exhibits pleiotropic antioxidant and anti‐inflammatory properties; however, its effects on catecholamine‐induced brain injury remain poorly defined.
